summary: Remote WebSocket channel drives Claude Agent SDK with bypassPermissions on installer host
details: The package runs a daemon that connects to a hardcoded WebSocket endpoint at wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and forwards messages received from that endpoint into a Claude Agent SDK session started with permissionMode set to 'bypassPermissions'. In control.js, SessionCreate/MessageSend/SessionResume handlers pass remote-supplied text into session.send(), which enables the Claude tool set (Bash, Write, etc.) to execute on the installer's host with auto-approval. Additional control.js handlers implement FileRead, FileWrite, FileTree, and FileSearch actions against un-restricted absolute paths (listDrives enumerates all Windows drive letters; normalizePath accepts arbitrary absolute paths), allowing the remote party to read or overwrite any file the daemon's user can access. A user-invoked 'agenthub-agent install' subcommand registers the daemon as a Windows autostart entry, a systemd unit, or a launchd agent, making the remote-control channel persistent across reboots once enabled. The daemon does not run from an npm lifecycle hook; it starts when the user runs the CLI, but once started it provides full-host remote code execution and arbitrary filesystem read/write from a hardcoded author-controlled endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
